task: 10-class known-attack classification; Isolation Forest evaluated as benign-vs-attack

label_mapping.attack_cat: preserved source labels; Normal is benign

notes: Official testing-set rows are untouched until final evaluation.
The 20% validation partition is sampled only from official training data.
Reference split is stratified and is not treated as source-independent evidence.

features.policy: Training-only numeric/categorical inference; numeric median and categorical mode and one-hot vocabulary fitted on training partition; unseen categories ignored.

parameters.fit_population: Normal rows in training partition only
parameters.threshold: 5th percentile of validation Normal decision_function scores

limitations: This is the official UNSW-NB15 pair only, not the four raw partitions.
The result is not cross-dataset generalization evidence.
Official split provenance is preserved; inner validation is a seeded random stratified split of official training data.
